title: Quality rubric
description: Uniform frame for a per-artifact quality rubric. One rubric per artifact type (close, angle, diagnostic, ...). The frame is shared (this schema); the content is typed (one file per artifact). This is the function-pole-map pattern generalised to evaluation: same skeleton, typed entries. The judge (judge.md) scores the criteria; proxies.py scores the deterministic floor declared in `proxies`.

artifact.description: The artifact this rubric scores. Matches the golden frontmatter `artifact` and the judge invocation.

definition.description: One sentence: what this artifact is, where it surfaces.

target.description: The posture this artifact must hit. The single most important field: it is the standard the judge measures against and the doctrine the build aligns to.

supersedes.description: Optional: doctrine text this rubric's target intentionally moves beyond, pending a doctrine amendment. Names the dependency so the repo never silently contradicts itself.

criteria.description: Weighted, semantic criteria scored 0..1 by the judge. Weights sum to ~1.0.

fail.description: The concrete failure mode this criterion guards against.

proxies.description: Deterministic checks from proxies.py wired to this artifact. Each fires past `threshold` and pushes the verdict sharp (+weight) or mushy (-weight). The cheap floor under the judge, not a gate.

threshold.description: Signal value at/above which the check fires. Default 1.
